table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname= 
		CASE item.printable 
		WHEN 1 THEN item.name + CASE WHEN saledetail.saleitemdescription IS NULL OR LEN(saledetail.saleitemdescription) = 0 THEN '' ELSE CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + saledetail.saleitemdescription END
		ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) 
		END,   
	aliasname=item.customicode,   
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
	accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
	salecatcode=saleledger.salecatcode,
	address = dbo.customer.address1,   
	address2= dbo.customer.address2,  
	custcity=customer.city,   
	salesman = dbo.users.username,   
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	itemdesc=	MAX(Rtrim(ltrim(saledetail.saleitemdescription))),
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,   
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	Godown = (SELECT G.Name FROM Godown G WHERE G.GCode = saledetail.gcode),
	gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
	icode = saledetail.icode,   
	looseqty = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
	bonusqty = sum(saledetail.bonusqty),
	packqty = sum(saledetail.packqty),   
	packunits= saledetail.packunits, 
	saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
	discperc = saledetail.discperc,  
	itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,   
	salestax = saledetail.salestax,   
	Id = max(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),
	posted=saleledger.posted,   
	balance=ISNULL(saleledger.balance,0), 
	printbalance=saleledger.printbalance,
	amt=saleledger.amt,  
	unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
	gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
	invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	reprintcount=saleledger.Reprintingcounter,
	serverdate=getdate(),
	custcode=dbo.saleledger.custcode,
	salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=saleledger.smancode),
	messages=(select description from message where messagecode=saleledger.messagecode),
	salecomments1=saleledger.salecomments1,
	salecomments2=saleledger.salecomments2
FROM 
	saleledger,   
	saledetail,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item  
	
WHERE 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode BETWEEN :ar_SInvCode AND :ar_LInvCode AND  
	dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (:ar_custcode) AND
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode AND  
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND  
	dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND  
	dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode AND  
	dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode
GROUP BY
	saleledger.saleinvcode,
	saleledger.salecatcode,
	saleledger.headerno,   
	saleledger.date,   
	saleledger.discperc,   
	saleledger.misccharges,   
	saleledger.flatdisc,   
	saleledger.salestax,   
	saleledger.printbalance,
	saleledger.amt,  
	saleledger.posted,   
	saleledger.balance,
	saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	saleledger.custrefno,	
	saleledger.remarks,
	saleledger.printwaranty,
	saleledger.printbatch,
	saleledger.Reprintingcounter,
	saleledger.custcode,
	saleledger.smancode,
	saleledger.messagecode,
	saleledger.salecomments1,
	saleledger.salecomments2,
	dbo.accounts.name,   
	customer.address1,   
	customer.address2,  
	customer.salestaxregno  ,
	customer.city,  
	dbo.users.username,   
	item.name,
	item.customicode,   
	item.printable,   
	item.packingdesc,   
	saledetail.gcode,   
	saledetail.icode,   
	saledetail.packunits, 
	saledetail.saleprice,   
	saledetail.discperc,  
	saledetail.itemflatdisc,   
	saledetail.salestax,   
	saledetail.unitsalestax,   
	saledetail.gstperc,
	saledetail.saleitemdescription
ORDER BY 
	/*dbo.item.customicode,*/
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	ID
table.sort: saleinvcode A, godown A, itemname A

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: (  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for group 1) , 0)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2)  for group 1)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )  for group 1)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount  for group 1) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)
